## Walkthrough

Replay Navigation, Replay Speed, and Replay Transport commands now cancel an active replay cursor claim before dispatch. Their dial handlers ignore zero-tick events. The 3.6.0 changelog describes the cursor-walk and Replay Markers landing behavior.

### Changes

**Legacy replay cursor cancellation**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|:---|:---|
|**Legacy action command handling** <br> `packages/iracing-actions/src/shared/replay-cursor*`, `packages/iracing-actions/src/shared/replay-cursor.test-support.ts`, `packages/iracing-actions/src/actions/replay-navigation/*`, `packages/iracing-actions/src/actions/replay-speed/*`, `packages/iracing-actions/src/actions/replay-transport/*`, `packages/iracing-actions/src/actions/data/changelog.json`, `packages/iracing-actions/CLAUDE.md`, `packages/website/src/content/docs/changelog.mdx`|The three legacy replay actions cancel the cursor before sending commands. Their dial handlers ignore zero-tick events. Tests check cancellation order and unchanged cursor state when no command runs. The release notes describe the fix. |
